stimulus.en: A new note on the community board asks which island view should appear on the next postcard.
stimulus.zh-CN: 社区公告栏上多了一张便条，询问下一张明信片应该印哪处岛景。

stimulus.en: The shop has placed several new island-view postcards on a small display.
stimulus.zh-CN: 小店在展示架上摆出了几张新的岛景明信片。

memory_text.en: The participant paused to look at the ordinary island postcard display.
memory_text.zh-CN: 参与者停下来查看了普通的岛屿明信片陈列。

stimulus.en: A harbor worker has updated the public tide board with the next safe ferry window.
stimulus.zh-CN: 渡口工作人员更新了公共潮汐牌，写明了下一段适合渡船通行的时间。

label.zh-CN: 感谢 Kai 更新潮汐牌

stimulus.en: The lunch room is open. Choose where you would like to settle with your meal.
stimulus.zh-CN: 午餐时段已经开始。你可以看看餐厅，然后找个位置用餐。

event_facts: Five dining areas are available
The shared table conversation is light and ordinary
The participant may reply, ignore, change seats, finish, or leave
allowed_knowledge: The visible meal and current conversation
llm_context.response_style: Short natural game dialogue consistent with the resident profile

stimulus.en: Several tables are available. You can look more closely before deciding, or take your food outside.
stimulus.zh-CN: 餐厅里有几处可以坐的位置。你可以先仔细看看，也可以把餐点带到外面。

label.en: Look at the lively shared table

label.zh-CN: 看看 Chen 的安静餐桌

label.en: Look at the open central table
Look at the window corner table

text.en: Leo makes room and smiles. ‘Good timing. Are you just getting to know the island?’
text.zh-CN: Leo 笑着腾出位置：“来得正好。你还在熟悉这座岛吗？”

label.en: Order the meal to take away

stimulus.en: The conversation stays light. You can answer, keep listening, move, or finish your meal whenever you like.
stimulus.zh-CN: 桌边的聊天很轻松。你可以回应、继续听、换位置，或者随时吃完离开。

text.en: Leo nods and answers with an easy comment about the island day.
text.zh-CN: Leo 点点头，随意聊起今天岛上的安排。

text.en: Anna adds a brief joke about the gulls trying to inspect everyone’s lunch.
text.zh-CN: Anna 笑着说，海鸥大概想检查每个人的午餐。

stimulus.en: Chen gives a small nod and continues eating. Conversation is possible, but not expected.
stimulus.zh-CN: Chen 轻轻点头后继续吃饭。你可以交谈，也可以不说话。

text.en: Chen answers warmly and keeps the conversation unhurried.
text.zh-CN: Chen 温和地回应，没有催着把话题继续下去。

stimulus.en: You have a place for the meal. The rest of the restaurant carries on around you.
stimulus.zh-CN: 你已经找到了用餐的位置，餐厅里的人们继续着各自的午餐。

stimulus.en: The meal is packed. You can eat outside nearby or carry it with you.
stimulus.zh-CN: 餐点已经打包好。你可以在附近室外吃，也可以带着继续走。

stimulus.en: Anna mentions that she will be near the North Island landing at 14:00 and invites you to meet her there.
stimulus.zh-CN: Anna 说她 14:00 会在北岛码头附近，邀请你过去见面。

event_facts: The meeting is at 14:00
The destination is North Island
The participant would normally travel through Ferry Harbor

stimulus.en: ‘I’ll be by the North Island landing at two. If you’re free, come over and I’ll show you the north shore path.’
stimulus.zh-CN: “我两点会在北岛码头。如果你有空就过来，我带你看看北岸的小路。”

description.en: Travel through Ferry Harbor and meet Anna near the North Island landing at 14:00.
description.zh-CN: 经由渡船码头前往北岛，14:00 在北岛码头附近见 Anna。

text.en: ‘Take the ferry from the harbor. I’ll wait by the North Island landing at two.’
text.zh-CN: “从渡船码头坐船过来。我两点会在北岛码头旁等你。”

stimulus.en: The route goes through Ferry Harbor. Anna will wait near the North Island landing at 14:00.
stimulus.zh-CN: 路线需要经过渡船码头。Anna 会在 14:00 到北岛码头附近等你。

label.en: Add the meeting to today's plan
label.zh-CN: 把见面加入今天的安排

description.en: Travel through Ferry Harbor and meet Anna near the North Island landing at 14:00.
description.zh-CN: 经由渡船码头前往北岛，14:00 在北岛码头附近见 Anna。

stimulus.en: At the harbor, Kai points to a new notice: the afternoon ferry has been cancelled because of the weather.
stimulus.zh-CN: 到了渡船码头，Kai 指向一张新通知：由于天气原因，下午的渡船已经取消。

event_facts: The afternoon ferry is cancelled because of weather
The participant had a 14:00 meeting with Anna on North Island
No single response is preferred
A slower service route may be available after asking

stimulus.en: ‘The afternoon ferry is cancelled because of the weather,’ Kai says. The route to the North Island meeting is no longer available as planned.
stimulus.zh-CN: Kai 说：“因为天气原因，下午的渡船停航了。”原本前往北岛见面的路线无法按计划继续。

label.zh-CN: 问 Kai 有没有其他路线

text.en: ‘There is a slower maintenance launch later, but it takes the long way around. I can only confirm it if the weather holds.’
text.zh-CN: “晚些时候可能有一艘维修艇绕行，不过路程更久，也要看天气是否允许。”

label.en: Ask when the next ferry runs

text.en: ‘The next regular ferry is tomorrow morning. Today’s afternoon service will not resume.’
text.zh-CN: “下一班正常渡船是明天早上。今天下午不会恢复班次。”

text.en: Anna replies: ‘I saw the weather notice. We can change the time or meet somewhere on the main island instead.’
text.zh-CN: Anna 回复：“我看到天气通知了。我们可以改时间，或者改在主岛见面。”

label.en: Wait at the harbor for a while

label.zh-CN: 改去做岛上的其他事情

stimulus.en: You have more information now. The original ferry remains cancelled, and several ordinary ways forward are available.
stimulus.zh-CN: 你已经获得了更多信息。原渡船仍然停航，但现在有几种可以继续安排当天行程的方式。

text.en: Anna replies: ‘No problem. We can move the meeting or leave it for tomorrow.’
text.zh-CN: Anna 回复：“没关系。我们可以换地方，或者改到明天。”

label.zh-CN: 改去做岛上的其他事情

stimulus.en: Anna understands that the ferry is cancelled. She is open to changing the time, changing the meeting place, or dropping today's meeting.
stimulus.zh-CN: Anna 知道渡船停航了。她可以改时间、改见面地点，也可以取消今天的见面。

label.en: Meet in the Community Square instead
Write a short reply to Anna
label.zh-CN: 给 Anna 写一条简短回复

text.en: Anna replies briefly and leaves the next step open to you.
text.zh-CN: Anna 简短地回复，并把接下来的安排留给你决定。

label.zh-CN: 先回头考虑码头的其他办法

stimulus.en: Some time passes. The regular ferry is still cancelled; you can keep waiting or make another arrangement.
stimulus.zh-CN: 过了一段时间。正常渡船仍未恢复，你可以继续等待，也可以作出其他安排。

label.en: Ask to use the slower service route
label.zh-CN: 询问并选择较慢的绕行路线

text.en: Anna replies: ‘We can change the plan whenever you’re ready.’
text.zh-CN: Anna 回复：“等你决定好，我们随时可以改安排。”

label.zh-CN: 改去做岛上的其他事情

stimulus.en: Chen is arranging a small beach volleyball game for later today and asks whether you would like the fourth place.
stimulus.zh-CN: Chen 正在安排今天稍晚的一场小型海滩排球赛，问你是否愿意成为第四名参与者。

event_facts: The game is at the beach at 16:00 on day two
Chen, Nova, and Kai have three places
The game starts only if the participant becomes the fourth player and arrives while all three residents are present
allowed_knowledge: The named participants and agreed time
knowledge_boundary: Do not claim the game can start with fewer than four people

stimulus.en: ‘Nova, Kai, and I have three people for beach volleyball. We need exactly one more to start. Would you like to meet us by the lighthouse beach at four?’
stimulus.zh-CN: “Nova、Kai 和我已经有三个人了。海滩排球还差一人才能开始。下午四点来灯塔下的海滩吗？”

label.en: Agree to be the fourth player
label.zh-CN: 答应成为第四名参与者

description.en: Meet Chen, Nova, and Kai at the lighthouse beach at 16:00. The game starts only when all four people are present.
description.zh-CN: 16:00 到灯塔下的海滩与 Chen、Nova 和 Kai 会合。四人全部到齐后比赛才开始。

label.en: Ask who is playing and when

text.en: ‘Nova and Kai will be there with me. With you, that makes four. We will wait from four until just before six.’
text.zh-CN: “Nova 和 Kai 会和我一起过去。算上你正好四人。我们从四点等到将近六点。”

stimulus.en: Chen, Nova, and Kai will be at the lighthouse beach from 16:00. The match needs the participant as its fourth player.
stimulus.zh-CN: Chen、Nova 和 Kai 将在 16:00 到灯塔下的海滩。比赛需要玩家作为第四名参与者。

label.en: Add the game to today's plan
label.zh-CN: 把比赛加入今天的安排

description.en: Meet Chen, Nova, and Kai at the lighthouse beach at 16:00. The game starts only when all four people are present.
description.zh-CN: 16:00 到灯塔下的海滩与 Chen、Nova 和 Kai 会合。四人全部到齐后比赛才开始。

stimulus.en: Chen, Nova, and Kai are beside the volleyball net. With you here, all four places are filled and the game can begin.
stimulus.zh-CN: Chen、Nova 和 Kai 已经站在排球网旁。你到场后四人全部到齐，比赛可以开始了。

event_facts: The participant, Chen, Nova, and Kai are present
There are exactly four available players
The participant may play, watch the warm-up, or leave

stimulus.en: Kai checks the net one last time. Chen asks whether you want to start now, watch a short warm-up, or leave the others to change their plan.
stimulus.zh-CN: Kai 最后检查了一遍球网。Chen 问你是现在开始、先看看热身，还是离开让大家另作安排。

text.en: Nova serves the ball gently across the net while the group waits for your decision.
text.zh-CN: Nova 轻轻把球发过球网，大家等着你作决定。

stimulus.en: The warm-up is over. All four people are still present, so the match can begin whenever you choose.
stimulus.zh-CN: 热身结束了。四个人仍然都在场，你决定后比赛就可以开始。

content.en: Four players made it to the lighthouse beach, so we finally got the volleyball match going. Good game.
content.zh-CN: 灯塔海滩正好凑齐四个人，排球赛顺利开场了。打得很开心。

content.en: The markers, net, and all four players lined up at the beach today. The match was worth the setup.
content.zh-CN: 今天海滩上的标记、球网和四名球员都到齐了。这场比赛值得前面的准备。

content.en: We checked the net and played a complete four-person match below the lighthouse today.
content.zh-CN: 今天我们检查好球网，在灯塔下打完了一场完整的四人排球赛。

stimulus.en: Anna says Leo is keeping Harborlight open for a small final-evening party and asks whether you would like to stop by.
stimulus.zh-CN: Anna 说 Leo 会让港灯餐厅晚些关门，办一场小型的最后一晚派对，并问你是否愿意过去坐坐。

event_facts: The gathering begins at Harborlight Restaurant at 18:00 on day three
Leo is hosting
Mira and Anna plan to attend
The participant may accept, ask for details, or decline
knowledge_boundary: Do not promise activities outside the authored event

stimulus.en: ‘Leo is putting out tea and a few shared plates at six. Mira and I will be there. Come by if that sounds pleasant; it is fine to keep your evening open too.’
stimulus.zh-CN: “Leo 六点会准备茶和几盘可以分享的食物。Mira 和我也会去。你想来就过来，不安排这场聚会也完全没关系。”

description.en: Visit Harborlight Restaurant at 18:00. Leo is hosting, and Mira and Anna plan to attend.
description.zh-CN: 18:00 前往港灯餐厅。Leo 负责主持，Mira 和 Anna 计划参加。

label.en: Ask what the evening will be like

text.en: ‘Nothing formal—tea, shared food, and room to talk or leave whenever you like. Leo will start setting up at six.’
text.zh-CN: “没有正式流程，就是喝茶、分享食物，想聊天或随时离开都可以。Leo 六点开始准备。”

stimulus.en: The gathering begins at 18:00. Leo will host, with Mira and Anna attending. There is no fixed program and you may leave whenever you choose.
stimulus.zh-CN: 聚会 18:00 开始。Leo 主持，Mira 和 Anna 会参加。没有固定流程，你可以随时离开。

label.en: Add the party to the evening plan

description.en: Visit Harborlight Restaurant at 18:00. Leo is hosting, and Mira and Anna plan to attend.
description.zh-CN: 18:00 前往港灯餐厅。Leo 负责主持，Mira 和 Anna 计划参加。

stimulus.en: Leo has set out tea and shared plates. Mira and Anna are already here, and the evening remains informal.
stimulus.zh-CN: Leo 已经摆好茶和分享餐盘。Mira 和 Anna 也已经到了，今晚没有正式流程。

event_facts: Leo is hosting
Mira and Anna are present
The participant may help, talk, stay briefly, or leave
knowledge_boundary: Respect an immediate decision to leave

stimulus.en: Leo waves from the shared table. You can help with the last preparations, sit down to talk, stay only a short while, or leave.
stimulus.zh-CN: Leo 在多人桌旁向你挥手。你可以帮忙做最后准备、坐下聊天、只短暂停留，或者离开。

text.en: ‘Thanks. Put those cups anywhere along the shared table,’ Leo says, leaving you room to join at your own pace.
text.zh-CN: Leo 说：“谢谢，把杯子放在多人桌上就好。”他让你按自己的节奏加入。

label.en: Sit down and join the conversation

text.en: Leo makes room at the table. ‘We were comparing favorite places to watch the harbor lights.’
text.zh-CN: Leo 在桌旁让出位置：“我们正在聊从哪里看港口的灯最好。”

label.en: Stay for tea, then continue your evening
label.zh-CN: 喝杯茶后继续自己的安排

label.en: Leave and keep the evening open
label.zh-CN: 离开并保留自己的晚间安排

stimulus.en: The preparations are finished and conversation moves easily around the shared table. You can stay with the group or leave whenever you like.
stimulus.zh-CN: 准备工作已经完成，多人桌旁的聊天轻松地继续着。你可以留下，也可以随时离开。

label.en: Stay with the group for a while

content.en: A relaxed evening at Harborlight: tea, shared plates, and an easy conversation around the table.
content.zh-CN: 在港灯餐厅度过了轻松的一晚：有茶、分享餐盘，还有围桌的随意聊天。

content.en: Harborlight's small evening party went well. Thanks to everyone who shared the table and helped keep it easygoing.
content.zh-CN: 港灯餐厅的小型晚间派对很顺利。谢谢一起围桌、让气氛保持轻松的大家。

content.en: Tea and shared food turned into a pleasantly unhurried evening at Harborlight.
content.zh-CN: 茶和分享食物，让港灯餐厅的夜晚变得轻松而从容。
